svg.title: Diagonal with Curve II
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study after an inspected primary museum photograph. Geometry approximate; interpretive screen colour not calibrated. Observed slate-gray shaped canvas: convex upper boundary, straight lower diagonal and short upright ends. Oblique source photograph approximately rectified using museum overall dimensions; interpretive gray is not calibrated. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): source review remains unresolved for gray; prior provisional screen colors retained, not calibrated to original paint.
